hook.title: Patient ki details ko label lage boxes mein rakhiye
hook.md:
Pharmacist dawaiyon ko **label lage boxes** mein rakhta hai, taaki sahi dawa turant mil jaaye. Python bhi jaankari aise hi rakhta hai, **variables** mein.

Is lesson ke end tak aap ek patient ka naam, wazan aur dose variables mein rakhenge, aur unse dose calculate karenge.

learn: **Variable** kya hai, aur value kaise rakhein aur badlein
Chaar basic **data types**: integers, floats, strings aur booleans

explanation.heading: Variable kya hai?
explanation.md:
Pharmacy ki shelf par rakhe ek **label lage box** ke baare mein sochiye. Label batata hai ki andar kya hai; box us cheez ko rakhta hai.

**Variable** bhi aise hi kaam karta hai. Iska ek **naam** (label) hota hai aur yeh ek **value** (andar ki cheez) rakhta hai:

```python
dose_mg = 500
```

`=` ko **"rakho"** padhiye: *500 ko `dose_mg` naam ke box mein rakho*. Ise **assignment** kehte hain. Iska matlab ganit wala "barabar" nahi hai.

Value rakhne ke baad aap use naam se use kar sakte hain, aur kabhi bhi badal sakte hain:

```python
dose_mg = 500
dose_mg = 650
print("Dose:", dose_mg, "mg")
```

Yeh `Dose: 650 mg` print karta hai, kyunki box mein ab 650 hai.

callout.title: Variable
callout.md: Computer ki memory mein ek naam wali jagah jo ek value rakhti hai, jaise shelf par label laga box.

explanation.heading: Variables ke naam rakhna
explanation.md:
Variable ke naam kuch niyam maante hain:

- Sirf **letters, numbers aur underscores** (`_`) use karein, jaise `dose_mg`, `patient2`.
- **Number se shuru na karein**: `2nd_dose` nahi chalega; `dose_2` theek hai.
- **Spaces nahi**: `patient weight` nahi, `patient_weight` likhein.
- Naam **case-sensitive** hote hain: `weight` aur `Weight` do alag variables hain.
- **Python ke apne shabd use na karein**, jaise `True`, `if` ya `for`. Yeh khaas matlab wale **keywords** hain.

**Achhi aadat:** aise naam chuniye jo bataayein ki andar kya hai, small letters aur underscores ke saath, jaise `patient_weight_kg`. `x` ya `a1` jaise naam code ko baad mein samajhna mushkil bana dete hain.

explanation.heading: Chaar basic data types
explanation.md:
Har value ka ek **data type** hota hai, jo Python ko batata hai ki value kis tarah ki hai.

| Data type | Python naam | Kya rakhta hai | Pharmacy example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Integer** | `int` | Poori sankhyayein | `tablets = 30` |
| **Float** | `float` | Dashamlav wali sankhyayein | `weight_kg = 52.5` |
| **String** | `str` | Quotes ke andar text | `drug = "Amoxicillin"` |
| **Boolean** | `bool` | Sirf `True` ya `False` | `in_stock = True` |

Dhyaan dijiye: `True` aur `False` **capital letter** se shuru hote hain, aur inme **quotes nahi** hote.

callout.title: Data type
callout.md: Value kis tarah ki hai: poori sankhya (int), dashamlav wali sankhya (float), text (str) ya True/False (bool).

explanation.heading: type() se type check karna
explanation.md:
Pakka nahi ki value ka type kya hai? `type()` se Python se poochiye:

```python
print(type(500))
print(type(52.5))
print(type("500"))
print(type(True))
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
<class 'int'>
<class 'float'>
<class 'str'>
<class 'bool'>
```

Teesri line dhyaan se dekhiye: `"500"` **quotes** mein hai, isliye yeh **text** hai, number nahi.

explanation.heading: Data types kyun zaroori hain
explanation.md:
Python numbers aur text ke saath bilkul alag tarah se kaam karta hai. Inhe compare kijiye:

```python
dose = 500
print(dose * 3)
```

`1500` print karta hai, lekin

```python
dose = "500"
print(dose * 3)
```

`500500500` print karta hai. Text ke saath `*` guna karne ke bajaay text ko **dohraata** hai.

callout.title: Pharmacy mein yeh bahut maayne rakhta hai
callout.md: Galti se text ke roop mein rakha gaya number, 1500 mg ki dose ko bematlab 500500500 bana sakta hai. Hamesha check kijiye ki doses aur wazan numbers hon, strings nahi.

steps.say: Yeh program ek patient ki details variables mein rakhta hai, aur phir unhe use karta hai. Har line chalte samay Variables panel dekhiye.
Pehli line ek comment hai. Yeh batati hai ki program kis baare mein hai.
Yahan equals sign ka matlab hai rakho. Python, text Ananya ko patient_name naam ke box mein rakhta hai. Yeh quotes mein hai, isliye yeh string hai.
weight_kg mein baavan dashamlav paanch rakha gaya hai. Isme dashamlav hai, isliye iska data type float hai.
dose_mg_per_kg mein das rakha gaya hai, ek poori sankhya. Iska data type int hai, yaani integer.
in_stock mein True rakha gaya hai, capital T ke saath. Jo values sirf True ya False hoti hain, unhe booleans kehte hain.
Ab print variables use karta hai. Python har box ke andar dekhkar values dikhata hai.
Python baavan dashamlav paanch ko das se guna karta hai. Inme se ek float hai, isliye answer bhi float hai: paanch sau pachchees dashamlav shoonya.
Aakhir mein Python boolean dikhata hai. Aapne abhi chaar alag-alag data types rakhkar use kiye.

errors.intro: Variables use karna shuru karte samay yeh do errors sabse aam hain.

examples.title: Aisa naam use karna jo maujood hi nahi
examples.md: Variable ka naam `dose_mg` hai, lekin line 2 `dose` maang rahi hai. Python sirf wahi naam jaanta hai jo aapne banaye hain. Spelling check kijiye, capital letters bhi.

examples.title: Text aur number ko + se jodna
examples.md: `+` do strings ko jod sakta hai, lekin **string** aur **integer** ko nahi. Sabse aasaan fix hai + ki jagah comma lagana: `print("Dose:", 500)`. Doosra fix aap Lesson 1.4 mein seekhenge.

callout.title: TypeError
callout.md: Error jiska matlab hai ki us kaam ke liye galat data type ki value use ki gayi.

mistakes.mistake: Variable ke naam mein space daalna, jaise `patient weight = 52`
Naam number se shuru karna, jaise `2nd_dose = 250`
Naam mein hyphen use karna, jaise `dose-mg = 500`
mistakes.fix: Python `-` ko minus samajhta hai. Underscore use kijiye: `dose_mg = 500`.
Booleans capital letter se shuru hote hain: `True`, `False`.

mistakes.mistake: Number ko quotes mein rakhna, jaise `dose = "500"`
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, lekin `dose * 3` deta hai 500500500
mistakes.fix: Numbers ko bina quotes ke likhiye: `dose = 500`.

summary: **Variable** ek label laga box hai jo **value** rakhta hai; `=` ka matlab **rakho** hai, barabar nahi.
Naamon mein **letters, numbers aur underscores** hote hain, yeh number se shuru nahi hote, inme spaces nahi hote, aur yeh **case-sensitive** hote hain.
Chaar basic **data types** hain **int** (30), **float** (52.5), **str** ("Amoxicillin") aur **bool** (True / False).
**`type()`** value ka data type dikhata hai; quotes mein likhi har cheez **string** hai, "500" bhi.
Data types se result badalta hai: `500 * 3` hai 1500, lekin `"500" * 3` hai 500500500.

steps.say: Variable, pharmacy ki shelf par rakhe label lage box jaisa hai. Label uska naam hai, aur andar value hai.
Alag-alag boxes alag tarah ki values rakh sakte hain: text, dashamlav wali sankhya, ya True ya False.
Python yaad rakhta hai ki har box mein kis tarah ki value hai. Ise data type kehte hain: int, str, float aur bool.
Aap andar ki cheez badal sakte hain. Ab dose_mg box mein paanch sau nahi, saadhe chhe sau hai.
Jab aap naam use karte hain, Python box ke andar dekhkar abhi wali value use karta hai.
